title: Towel Shelf With Drying Rack 24.7-Inch Solid Brass, 3-Tier Wall Mount | Oil Rubbed Bronze | Allied Brass
body_html:
Stop piling towels on the counter—store and dry them in one space-saving wall-mounted design in Oil Rubbed Bronze, which offers rich, dark brown tones with subtle copper highlights, bringing Old World character to any bathroom. This traditional towel shelf with drying rack keeps folded towels organized while giving you an integrated rack for towels that need to air out.

  • Oil Rubbed Bronze brings rich depth and character
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Maintain a clean, refined look thanks to concealed screw mounting hardware.
  • Coordinate your space with multiple designer finish options available for matching traditional bathroom hardware and classic bath accessories.
  • Long-term confidence with a Limited Lifetime Warranty.

Specs & Installation
Material: Brass
Mounting: Wall mount (concealed screw mounting)
Dimensions (L × W × H): 24.7 in × 8.9 in × 10.4 in
Projection: 3.5 in
Weight: 5.6 lb
Assembly: Some assembly required
Included: Towel shelf arms (3), back plate, and all installation hardware
Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
